up: List all molecules reported in the document with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL5729701. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, molecule type, and maximum clinical phase.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.molecule_type, md.max_phase FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729701'
